svg.aria-label: What runs where. wsl-shrinker.exe, the Windows program, reads the disks, runs each shrink and draws the screen or prints the commands. In a Windows terminal it takes the keys and shows the screen itself. In a WSL terminal, wsl-shrinker is the Linux build: it draws the screen there and asks wsl-shrinker.exe for every answer as JSON lines. wsl-shrinker.exe asks wsl.exe to list, stop, start and compact distributions and to run scripts inside them, compacts Docker Desktop's disk and other files through Windows' virtual disk API, and reads every disk file directly, without mounting it.
